verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo produces AI insights and suggestions from the user's own project data inside the product. It runs false-positive detection with confidence scores and explanations on security findings, analyzes failed dependency-bump pipelines to propose fixes, and offers agentic vulnerability resolution. The evidence covers only security and pipeline contexts, and the false-positive feature requires Ultimate plus a Duo add-on. missing for 10: evidence of AI insights beyond security/CI data (e.g. issues, planning or analytics data), independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality, and documentation of availability outside the Ultimate/Duo add-on tier.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: false positive detection runs automatically after each security scan and provides confidence scores with explanations for each assessment
GitLab Duo can analyze the failure and provide fixes to resolve it
This agentic approach uses multi-shot reasoning to resolve vulnerabilities with minimal human intervention.
